newsitem.title: USA: MCN sees higher capital investments in '97.
newsitem.headline: MCN sees higher capital investments in '97.

text.p: MCN Energy Group Inc said Tuesday it expects to make capital investments of more than $800 million in 1997, which should help the diversified energy holding company post record results this year.
MCN said 80 percent of the funds will go to its Diversified Energy unit, with the remainder for Gas Distribution. Of the Diversified money, more than half is for exploration and production projects.
The rest will go for electric power generation, gas gathering and processing projects.
"With such opportunities, we expect 1997 to be another year of record financial results," MCN Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer Alfred Glancy said in a statement.
Capital investments in 1996 totalled about $800 million. Glancy said the investment opportunities in the energy industry could enable the firm to double its asset base through 2000.

The company posted fourth quarter net income of $41.7 million, up from $40.6 million, including discontinued operations. MCN has $3.6 billion in assets with natural gas markets and investments throughout North America. It has also begun entering overseas markets.
